In the elven camp of {wiki:Shadowthorn|Shadowthorn}, in the swamps southeast of Venore, a large tower guarded by elves rises up. Reach the tower from above or below the camp, climb the five floors fighting {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, and open the two boxes at the top to take a {item:Bow}, arrows, sapphires and potions.
Health potions: the Elf Scouts and Elf Arcanists attack from a distance
optional, helps to cross the swamp to Shadowthorn
optional, helps to cross the swamp to Shadowthorn
There are two paths to the tower (above or below the camp); pick one and follow the images.
The two {creature:Dragon|Dragons} on the 3rd floor are only accessible from above and cannot reach you, but you may run into them if you take a wrong turn.

Start from **Venore** and leave the city by the **east exit**. Cross the swamps to the **southeast** to the elven camp of {wiki:Shadowthorn|Shadowthorn} (the map shows the fastest route; there are others). A {item:Machete} and a {item:Shovel} are not mandatory, but they help to cross the swamp. From the entrance you have two paths to the tower: from above (option A) or from below (option B).
Fastest route from Venore (east exit) to Shadowthorn
Go up the stairs to the west
Enter the camp and go straight **west**; go up the stairs.
Path from above: stairs west of the entrance
Going down next to the tower
Follow the path **west** and then **south** until you see the big tower in the middle of the camp; go down the stairs.
Path from above to the stairs next to the tower
Go down the stairs to the east
Enter the camp and go straight **east**; go down the stairs.
Underground path: stairs east of the entrance
Follow the passage always **southwest** and go up the stairs.
Underground passage to the stairs up
Head **east** to the big tower and start climbing.
Clear each floor as you go up:
2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} (only accessible from above, they cannot reach you)
On the last floor there are two {item:Box|boxes} with the rewards. Open both.
2 Small Sapphires, 30 Burst Arrows, 60 Poison Arrows, Bow, 1 Health Potion and 1 Mana Potion

Go back the same way: go down the five floors of the tower, head **west** and redo the option you used (go up the stairs next to the tower and go back along the top to the **north** and **east**, or go down the stairs and follow the passage **northeast** to the stairs up east of the entrance). Then leave Shadowthorn and cross the swamps to the **northwest** to the east exit of **Venore**.
